_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; scenario P/E = percentiles of ACN's own 10-yr P/E on current-FY EPS; EPP P/E = median panic trough

pit_profile.why: Accenture: #1-scale IT-services and consulting franchise that took share through the cloud cycle; discretionary consulting demand is cyclical, the franchise is not

theme_watch.reason: Live since 2022-11-30, but the only evidence is the product itself — no sell-side or price read on IT services yet — and the stock trades at 24.7x FY23E — near its own median, not an AI discount. Re-file under AI_EXPOSED only when the multiple starts discounting deflation or GenAI shows up as shrinking billable hours.

classification.quality_note: Accenture: #1-scale IT-services and consulting franchise that took share through the cloud cycle; discretionary consulting demand is cyclical, the franchise is not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price fair; Ratio B 0.93x; +37% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.12; conservative 2yr +2%.

BEAR.desc: Consulting recession spreads to managed services; pricing concessions; P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: Mid-single-digit LC growth, 10-20bp/yr margin, buyback; P/E reverts to its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: GenAI becomes a cloud-sized services cycle; growth back to 8-10% LC; P/E holds 75th pct

XBULL.desc: Re-run of the FY21-22 boom: double-digit growth and a 30x multiple

robustness.variant: EPP at 21x (near the 2022-23 trough, no v2 penalty)

summary: ACN (retrospective, 2023-01-20) ◎ ACCUMULATE — Ratio B 0.93x (28.0% downside to Bear $202 / +30.1% upside to Bull $365) | Adj composite 2.95 vs market 3.07: gap -0.12 [FAIRLY VALUED] | +37% above the EPP floor $204 (18x FY23E $11.36) | Conservative 2-yr case: +1.5% total (+0.8%/yr) | At 24.7x FY23E the 15% hurdle price $371 sits above the BULL case while consulting has slowed to +10% LC (from +22%) and Q2 is guided to +6-10% LC; GenAI is a live theme but priced as a tailwind, not a threat.
